newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens against dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens against dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritius rupee weakened against the dollar and pound on Wednesday, reflecting international trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial rate of 20.1285 against the dollar from 20.0840 on Tuesday. Against the pound, the rupee was quoted at a mean rate of 33.4835 from 33.4635.
Dealers said the rupee's fixing on Wednesday morning was in line with the dollar strengthening in overnight international markets.

"The central bank showed an intention this morning of selling dollars at five cents below the interbank market rate," said a dealer, adding it was too early to say whether commercial banks bought dollars from the central bank to support the rupee.
